sentences.zh: 星期六，小美和爸爸去公园。
sentences.py: Xīng qī liù, Xiǎo Měi hé bà ba qù gōng yuán.
sentences.en: On Saturday, Xiao Mei and Dad go to the park.

sentences.zh: 公园里有树林，也有大草地。
sentences.py: Gōng yuán lǐ yǒu shù lín, yě yǒu dà cǎo dì.
sentences.en: The park has woods and a big lawn.

sentences.zh: 小美坐在岩石上，看花园里的花。
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi zuò zài yán shí shang, kàn huā yuán lǐ de huā.
sentences.en: Xiao Mei sits on a rock and looks at the flowers in the garden.

sentences.zh: 这里的空气真好！
sentences.py: Zhè lǐ de kōng qì zhēn hǎo!
sentences.en: The air here is so fresh!

sentences.zh: 早上下雨了，小美在家看书。
sentences.py: Zǎo shang xià yǔ le, Xiǎo Měi zài jiā kàn shū.
sentences.en: In the morning it rains, so Xiao Mei reads at home.

sentences.zh: 雨停了，太阳出来了。
sentences.py: Yǔ tíng le, tài yáng chū lái le.
sentences.en: The rain stops and the sun comes out.

sentences.zh: 天上有彩虹，真美！
sentences.py: Tiān shàng yǒu cǎi hóng, zhēn měi!
sentences.en: There's a rainbow in the sky, so pretty!

sentences.zh: 晚上，小美看到月亮和星星。
sentences.py: Wǎn shang, Xiǎo Měi kàn dào yuè liàng hé xīng xing.
sentences.en: At night, Xiao Mei sees the moon and the stars.

sentences.zh: 小美和妈妈去郊外玩。
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi hé mā ma qù jiāo wài wán.
sentences.en: Xiao Mei and Mum go to the countryside to play.

sentences.zh: 忽然，天上来了很多乌云。
sentences.py: Hū rán, tiān shàng lái le hěn duō wū yún.
sentences.en: Suddenly, lots of dark clouds fill the sky.

sentences.zh: 刮风了，还有闪电！
sentences.py: Guā fēng le, hái yǒu shǎn diàn!
sentences.en: The wind blows, and there's lightning too!

sentences.zh: 妈妈打伞，她们快快回家。
sentences.py: Mā ma dǎ sǎn, tā men kuài kuài huí jiā.
sentences.en: Mum opens her umbrella and they hurry home.

sentences.zh: 回到家，大家都很开心。
sentences.py: Huí dào jiā, dà jiā dōu hěn kāi xīn.
sentences.en: Back home, everyone is happy.

sentences.zh: 小美看日历，明天是星期六。
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi kàn rì lì, míng tiān shì xīng qī liù.
sentences.en: Xiao Mei looks at the calendar; tomorrow is Saturday.

sentences.zh: 新加坡天气炎热，今天也很晴朗。
sentences.py: Xīn jiā pō tiān qì yán rè, jīn tiān yě hěn qíng lǎng.
sentences.en: Singapore's weather is hot, and today is clear and sunny too.

sentences.zh: 小美说：“我想去寒冷的地方看雪！”
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng qù hán lěng de dì fang kàn xuě!"
sentences.en: Xiao Mei says, "I want to go somewhere cold to see snow!"

sentences.zh: 爸爸说：“好，等有时间，我们就去。”
sentences.py: Bà ba shuō: "Hǎo, děng yǒu shí jiān, wǒ men jiù qù."
sentences.en: Dad says, "OK, when we have time, we'll go."

l18.title: 小美的太空书
l18.titlePinyin: Xiǎo Měi de tài kōng shū

sentences.zh: 小美在看太空书。
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi zài kàn tài kōng shū.
sentences.en: Xiao Mei is reading a space book.

sentences.zh: 我们住在地球上，月球离地球很近。
sentences.py: Wǒ men zhù zài dì qiú shang, yuè qiú lí dì qiú hěn jìn.
sentences.en: We live on Earth, and the Moon is close to Earth.

sentences.zh: 海王星和天王星离我们很远。
sentences.py: Hǎi wáng xīng hé tiān wáng xīng lí wǒ men hěn yuǎn.
sentences.en: Neptune and Uranus are very far from us.

sentences.zh: 彗星有长长的尾巴，真好看！
sentences.py: Huì xīng yǒu cháng cháng de wěi ba, zhēn hǎo kàn!
sentences.en: Comets have long tails, they look so nice!

sentences.zh: 宇宙很大，地球是我们的家。
sentences.py: Yǔ zhòu hěn dà, dì qiú shì wǒ men de jiā.
sentences.en: The universe is very big, and Earth is our home.

sentences.zh: 我们要爱护环境。
sentences.py: Wǒ men yào ài hù huán jìng.
sentences.en: We should take care of the environment.

sentences.zh: 小美把垃圾放进垃圾桶，还会节约用水。
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi bǎ lā jī fàng jìn lā jī tǒng, hái huì jié yuē yòng shuǐ.
sentences.en: Xiao Mei puts rubbish in the bin, and saves water too.

sentences.zh: 老师说：“小美很环保！”
sentences.py: Lǎo shī shuō: "Xiǎo Měi hěn huán bǎo!"
sentences.en: The teacher says, "Xiao Mei is very eco-friendly!"

l20.title: 中秋节的晚上
l20.titlePinyin: Zhōng qiū jié de wǎn shang

sentences.zh: 中秋节的晚上，小美用望远镜看夜空。
sentences.py: Zhōng qiū jié de wǎn shang, Xiǎo Měi yòng wàng yuǎn jìng kàn yè kōng.
sentences.en: On Mid-Autumn night, Xiao Mei looks at the night sky with a telescope.

sentences.zh: 妈妈给她讲嫦娥的神话故事。
sentences.py: Mā ma gěi tā jiǎng Cháng'é de shén huà gù shi.
sentences.en: Mum tells her the myth of Chang'e.

sentences.zh: 小美说：“我长大了要坐航天飞机去月亮上看看！”
sentences.py: Xiǎo Měi shuō: "Wǒ zhǎng dà le yào zuò háng tiān fēi jī qù yuè liàng shang kàn kan!"
sentences.en: Xiao Mei says, "When I grow up, I want to ride a space shuttle to the moon!"

sentences.zh: 爸爸笑着说：“也许你还会见到外星人呢！”
sentences.py: Bà ba xiào zhe shuō: "Yě xǔ nǐ hái huì jiàn dào wài xīng rén ne!"
sentences.en: Dad smiles and says, "Maybe you'll even meet an alien!"
